promptVars.SUBJECT: a Korean baekja/celadon porcelain wine bottle (백자·청자 술병), rendered as a smooth CERAMIC vessel -- explicitly NOT a wooden or lacquered object, and NOT warm brown. Same silhouette as before: a tall bottle with a full rounded lower body that tapers smoothly into a narrower neck and ends in a small flared mouth rim, standing on a slightly recessed flat foot ring; a single smooth continuous curve, entirely free of handles, spouts, ears, or a lid. Render this as a DEEP CELADON glaze piece: most of the body's facets are this set's deep muted teal (#274A3F) -- a rich, clearly-visible blue-green glaze colour, not a faint accent -- with the lighter stoneGrey (#8B8478) appearing only on the upper-lit facets (shoulder and neck highlights) and a thin dancheong-gold (#BD924C) line at the rim. The overall read must be a saturated blue-green celadon glaze vessel, matte, with soft tonal facet variation -- clearly ceramic, not wood.
